one_liner: SendGrid has a broad REST v3 API using API-key auth and a free trial (no credit card), with continued sending needing a paid plan; only community MCP servers are evidenced.
auth_notes: Users create an API key in Settings > API Keys and supply it to the client. No OAuth for third-party developers appears in the pages.
access_notes: The homepage advertises a free trial with no credit card required. The trial terms (60 days, 100/day) and the paid-plan requirement afterward come from a support page that is not among the provided pages, so they are unverified here.
blocker_notes: Access is through a free trial; sustained use likely needs a paid plan (not confirmed by the provided pages). Each user must create and paste their own API key (no OAuth).

evidence.quote: A Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that provides access to SendGrid's Marketing API for email marketing and contact management.
This server is for **transactional send and delivery**, not a map of the whole SendGrid API.
